evidence.title: Migration file exists and is correct

evidence.title: DBTX interface pattern in shared/dbtx.go
evidence.description: New shared.DBTX interface defines ExecContext, QueryContext, QueryRowContext — satisfied by both *sql.DB and *sql.Tx. Both validation.SQLRepository and deployments.SQLApprovalsRepository refactored to use DBTX internally with WithTx(tx) methods.

evidence.title: Bridging logic in SubmitReview
evidence.description: handler.go SubmitReview: begins tx on h.db, calls sqlRepo.WithTx(tx).UpdateReview, then if git_commit_hash is non-NULL creates deployment approval via approvalsRepo.WithTx(tx).Create with validation_id set. Maps review decision directly to approval status. Commits atomically or rolls back. Legacy validations (NULL hash) use non-transactional fallback path. Reviewer defaults to 'operator' when empty.

evidence.title: Types correctly updated — orphaned field removed
evidence.description: validation.Record has GitCommitHash field, no orphaned ApprovalID. validation.Request has GitCommitHash. ReviewResponse has ApprovalID and ApprovalStatus. All JSON tags match API contract.

evidence.title: Server wiring updated
evidence.description: server.go passes approvalsRepo and db to validation.NewHandler(), ensuring bridging dependencies are injected at startup.

evidence.title: UI approval status badge in VideoReviewPanel

evidence.description: cli/validations/commands.go: --commit flag on runValidation (required, error if missing). Review output parses enriched response to show approval_id and approval_status. List command has --commit filter flag.
